scope: Uncalibrated illustrative site-control simulation; no field suppression claim
threshold_purpose: Demo operating settings, not regulatory limits
forecast_trajectory_rule: Linear source-proxy path from current reading to the frozen learned 30-second endpoint; known past source/wind for queued transport; future wind held at latest observed direction; untreated boundary rollout
warmup_rule: 120 seconds of assumed quiet source-proxy readings before scenario clock zero
measurement_rule: Noise-free synthetic source-proxy/boundary observations; identical dropout times for every strategy
missing_data_rule: Reactive/predictive request all zones while boundary observations unavailable, with common actuator limits. Predictive falls back to reactive until 121 source snapshots are complete.
